description: This file provides functions related to managing and executing hooks within a Git repository, such as finding, verifying, and running hooks with specific options.

methods.name: const char * find_hook(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Locates the hook script in the repository's hooks directory and checks if it is executable.

methods.name: int hook_exists(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific hook exists and is executable in the repository.

methods.name: int run_hooks_opt(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Executes hooks with specified options, managing the process startup and callbacks.

methods.name: int run_hooks(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name)
methods.description: Runs hooks with default options for a specific hook name.

methods.name: int run_hooks_l(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,...)
methods.description: Runs hooks with additional arguments provided variadically.

methods.name: int notify_hook_finished(int result,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cb UNUSED)
int notify_start_failure(struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cp UNUSED)
int pick_next_hook(struct child_process * cp,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void ** pp_task_cb UNUSED)
